Let \(t=\tan x^\circ\). The equation is

\[
\tan 53^\circ \tan 81^\circ \, t=\tan 53^\circ+\tan 81^\circ+t.
\]

Rearrange:

\[
(\tan 53^\circ \tan 81^\circ-1)t=\tan 53^\circ+\tan 81^\circ.
\]

Thus

\[
t=\frac{\tan 53^\circ+\tan 81^\circ}{\tan 53^\circ \tan 81^\circ-1}.
\]

Using the tangent addition formula,

\[
\tan(53^\circ+81^\circ)=\frac{\tan 53^\circ+\tan 81^\circ}{1-\tan 53^\circ \tan 81^\circ}.
\]

So

\[
t=-\tan(134^\circ)=\tan(46^\circ).
\]

Since \(0<x<180\) and \(\tan x^\circ=\tan 46^\circ\), we get

\[
x=46.
\]

\[
\boxed{46}
\]
